title: Spell tooltips that say what it does
quote: I see 'Spirit Link Totem' on the list and have no idea if I should care or what it does for my group.
what: Hover a spell row, a lane icon or an Essentials entry and a tooltip shows the normal spell text plus one plain line like 'Big group heal and damage cut, use when everyone is low'. The tooltip also says who owns it and when it comes back.
today: Today: rows show icon, name and timer only; only the Rez button and minimap have tooltips

title: Easy mode with a short list
quote: 29 spells is way too much for me, I just want to know about the stuff that matters.
what: A first-run choice in settings: Simple (Battle Rez, Bloodlust, big heals only), Normal, or Everything. Simple hides the rest without making me untick each spell.
today: Today: you untick spells one by one in Settings; no presets

title: First-run welcome and /cdc help
quote: I installed it, nothing happened, and I typed /cdc help and got my panel hidden instead.
what: A one-time chat message after install says what the addon does and the three commands to know. An unknown word like /cdc help lists the commands in plain words instead of toggling the panel.
today: Today: any unknown /cdc word just shows or hides the panel; no help text

title: Why is the panel empty? message
quote: It says 'No cooldowns tracked' and I can't tell if it's broken or my friends just don't have it.
what: The empty panel explains the reason: 'Nobody else in your group runs this addon yet' on Retail and Forever, or 'Waiting for someone to use a tracked spell' on the combat log clients. It also offers a copy-paste invite line to send to the group.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever

title: Ready alert for the spells I own
quote: I forget I even have Lay on Hands until the boss is already dead.
what: A small sound and a brief icon flash on screen when one of my own tracked spells comes off cooldown, with an on/off box and a sound choice.
today: Today: it tells the group when my spell is ready, but nothing alerts me

title: Saved layouts for party and raid
quote: I resized everything for dungeons and then a raid invite wrecked my screen.
what: Pick a layout once for 5-man and once for raid, and it switches by itself when the group size changes. Includes a 'put everything back to default' button for all frames, not just the main panel.
today: Today: /cdc reset moves only the main panel; one saved position

title: Getting Started tab in Settings
quote: I don't know which of the three windows I actually need, or how to move them.
what: A first tab with a picture of each window (Panel, Essentials, Lanes), one line on what each is for, and tick boxes to turn them on or off. It also has Lock and Reset buttons next to the explanations.
today: Today: Settings is a list of options with slash command alternatives only in the website text

title: Warn me when my own big spell is about to be wasted
quote: I don't want to be the one who used Bloodlust at the pull when the healer needed it.
what: When I am a Bloodlust or Battle Rez provider, show a small 'You are the Rez' or 'You are the Lust' reminder on the Essentials bar so I know the group is counting on me. No automatic casting.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever
today: Today: the bar lists ready providers by name, no personal reminder

title: Plain-words reason when a player is missing
quote: A friend's name is not on the list and I can't tell if they are out of range, too low level or just have no addon.
what: Roster lists each group member with a short reason like 'no addon', 'not high enough level', or 'nothing to track for this class'. It helps me know who to ask instead of guessing.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever
today: Today: /cdc roster prints capabilities only, no reasons

title: Group cooldowns without CDTL3 needing setup help
quote: The description says install CDTL3 for lanes but I don't know what lanes are or if I need that.
what: If CDTL3 is not installed, Settings shows a short plain note that explains what it adds and a link to copy. If it is installed, a button jumps straight to the right CDTL3 page and sets Caster lane for me.
today: Today: the box only shows when CDTL3 is loaded; steps are in the description
